latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of upstage-ocr.
- Extract plain text and word-level bounding box coordinates from images and scanned documents using the Upstage OCR API.
- Supports synchronous (≤100 pages) and asynchronous (≤1000 pages) processing.
- Handles a wide range of formats including JPEG, PNG, BMP, PDF, TIFF, HEIC, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HWP, HWPX.
- Provides examples for both sync and async workflows with details on file output and usage tips.
